title: Model cards compared, pack 4: what frontier developers’ cards disclose
status: Candidate research pack outside application data. Prepared by Claude on 2026-11-06, with a fresh-context same-family audit of a seeded sample (audit.md). The blind cross-family check by Codex (GPT family) covered packs 4 and 5 together (research/model-cards-4/cross-family-check-2026-11-07.md) and was adjudicated on 2026-11-09 (research/model-cards-4/adjudication/apply-2026-11-09.mjs); one cell is held for the maintainer (†). Not editorially accepted; no human review.
selectionRule: Decision 1a: every card that cites the developer’s frontier framework or states a determination under it, plus, for each developer, the latest card before its first framework edition. This pack drafts the eight cards of pack 4 in research/model-cards-2/population.md’s adjudicated order (packs 4 and 5 follow pack 3); completed packs are not repeated here.
